acceptance_criteria.condition: A timeout or raw-numeric state-space repair requires an explicit shape, worst-case, bound, and stress-probe gate before completion.

The independent corpus has at least 20 tasks spanning every registered stratum; every fixture fails at least one public case and every hidden expected value matches the deterministic reference contract.
The v5 model, Harness, Skill hash, corpus, scorer, prompts, generator, randomized order, stopping rule, and inference thresholds are frozen before the first trial.

invariants: v4 hidden cases are not reused as v5 hidden contracts.
The repair agent receives only the task workspace, public cases, test harness, and treatment Skill path.
A correct non-unique result is never rejected for differing from an arbitrary rendering because this corpus uses only unambiguous scalar, boolean, or canonical list outputs.
Only a completed v5 analysis with decision improved can support the scoped repair-success claim.

safeguards.name: front-loaded budget repair gate
safeguards.rationale: The resource rule is placed before the causal workflow so an Agent that reads only the Skill prefix receives it.

safeguards.name: fresh synthetic hidden corpus
safeguards.rationale: v5 uses newly generated task IDs and cases rather than the v4 QuixBugs hidden files; the generator and manifest are committed before collection.

safeguards.name: scorer-contract scope
safeguards.rationale: This corpus excludes multiple-valid-output functions so exact comparison remains a valid contract for every task.

design_boundary.rationale: The Skill owns the workflow gate; the generator owns corpus materialization; the existing runner and scorer remain the execution and blind-scoring boundaries.

dependency_audit.rationale: Only Python standard library and existing project scripts are used.

extension_decision.rationale: No public extension contract is added.

data_ownership.rationale: The committed corpus owns its public and hidden case data; runner artifacts are generated only after preregistration.

error_model.rationale: Fixture public failure, timeout, incomplete trial, hidden failure, and scope violation remain explicit non-passing states.

contract_evolution.rationale: The Skill gains an explicit budget gate and the README distinguishes v4's valid negative result from v5's unrun protocol.

operational_budget.rationale: The corpus contains explicit one-second resource contracts and the Skill requires complexity and stress-probe evidence.

threat_boundary.rationale: Hidden cases and references are scorer-only by protocol; native workspace isolation remains a documented limitation.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: The Skill rule, corpus generator, corpus, preregistration, tests, evidence, and documentation are frozen together before formal collection.

release_recovery.rationale: This is an offline evaluation package, not a deployable service.

data_migration.rationale: No production data or schema changes.

configuration_secrets.rationale: No credentials or runtime secrets are stored.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: The v5 synthetic corpus introduces no external runtime dependency.

operational_knowledge.rationale: README and preregistration state the evaluation scope, limitations, and replay path.

reproducibility.rationale: Generator hash, manifest hash, model/Harness IDs, prompts, scorer, seed, order, and stopping rule are captured before trials.

verification.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 python3 -m unittest tests/test_skill_contract.py tests/test_effect_corpus_v5.py
verification.result: The Skill contract and generated corpus checks passed; all 22 fixtures require a visible repair and reference hidden contracts are consistent.
The frozen v5 protocol validates as not_run with no trial evidence.
No whitespace errors before preregistration commit.

rollback_or_compatibility: Revert the Budget-Aware Repair Gate, generator, corpus, tests, preregistration, README update, and this evidence artifact together; v4 results remain historical evidence.

independent_review.notes: The checks validate corpus consistency and preregistration shape, but they do not pre-judge the unrun treatment outcome.

supporting_artifacts.summary: Normative budget-aware repair gate placed near the Skill entry point.
Regression test for shape, bound, stress probe, semantic/performance separation, and non-unique-output rule.
Checks all fixtures have visible failures and all generated expected values and hashes are internally consistent.
Frozen v5 paired effect protocol with actual Skill, corpus, scorer, prompt, model, and Harness hashes.

remaining_risks: v5 is unrun at this commit; no repair-success claim is supported yet.
The synthetic corpus intentionally emphasizes explicit resource bounds and cannot represent all production causal-debugging work.
Native Codex execution is protocol-isolated rather than container-isolated.
